descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
You took the night shift because the pay was good. Nobody told you what walks the aisles after dark.

Welcome to your first shift at the greenhouse warehouse. The job sounds simple: read the order on your terminal, walk to the right shelf, punch in the keypad code, pack the item, seal the crate, and ship it before your daily quota runs out. Miss quota, and you're done.

But you're not alone in here.

HUNTED IN THE DARK
Something stalks the warehouse floor. You'll never hear it coming from a clean direction — just footsteps that grow louder as it closes in. Kill your flashlight, drop into a crouch, and slip under the shelving. If it spots you, it screams and charges. Your only edge is knowing where it can't reach you.

RUN — BUT NOT FOREVER
Sprinting drains your stamina fast. Push too hard and you're stuck walking, wide open, while the bar refills. Every escape is a gamble on how much you've got left in the tank.

WORK UNDER PRESSURE
This isn't just hide-and-seek. You have a job to do. Match every order to the correct shelf, solve the symbol keypad, pack the right item, and get it shipped clean. Ship the wrong thing or leave a crate unsealed and you lose the payout — and burn precious time you don't have.

SPEND TO SURVIVE
Earn money and spend it at the shop — a flashlight to cut the dark, a scanner to work faster, an oxygen capsule to buy yourself a second chance. Every purchase is a bet on what keeps you alive longer.

EVERY NIGHT GETS WORSE
Higher quotas. Tighter margins. A
